Grassi Investment Management Stake in United Tech (UTX) Lifted by $818,750 as Market Valuation Declined; As Apple (AAPL) Stock Value Rose, Doheny Asset Management Trimmed Its Holding
June 1, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Grassi Investment Management increased its stake in United Tech (UTX) by 14.91% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Grassi Investment Management bought 6,550 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.23% with the market. The institutional investor held 50,475 shares of the aerospace company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.35M, up from 43,925 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Grassi Investment Management who had been investing in United Tech for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $100.66B market cap company. The stock increased 0.79% or $0.99 during the last trading session, reaching $125.81. About 2.66 million shares traded. United Technologies Corporation (NYSE:UTX) has risen 3.91% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.66% the S&P500.
Doheny Asset Management decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 7.14% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Doheny Asset Management sold 6,230 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined.
